notes: Bridge orange and cable structure largely lost; heavy stroke texture smears the span. Scene still reads as a bridge but identity is weakened.
Canal and building masses held; windows and edges turn mushy under the brush texture. Impressionist but a bit generic.
Meadow and peaks survive; broken color on the flowers works. Peaks slightly softened, no major artifacts.
Cathedral facade reads as a real photograph. Stone courses, windows, and sky held; brushwork fully removed.
Garden reads photographic. Foliage clumps a little and some petal identity is simplified, otherwise clean.
Boats and masts look photographic. Water is slightly flat and plastic compared with a real harbor shot.
Pond layout held, but lilies stay soft and painterly. Petal groups drift; incomplete photo conversion.
Red boat, quay, and reflections preserved. Strokes are visible, though the boat remains a bit graphic rather than fully painted.
Japanese bridge and garden read as a real photo. Mild residual softness in the foliage only.
Lake and mountain silhouette held; reflection is painterly. Closer to generic impressionism than a specific Monet handling.
Cranes and harbor layout recognizable. Industrial edges are noisy and smeared; texture looks overlaid.
Parasol figure reads as an outdoor portrait photo. Face and dress folds are simplified but pose and setting hold.
Rotunda and colonnade stay legible. Style is moderate impressionism; architecture is unusually well preserved.
Bridge, willows, and reflection preserved and de-painterized. Water still a little soft, not fully camera-sharp.
Bridge structure held. Lilies and water look processed and flat; some loss of lily identity.
Harbor looks like a real photograph. Small craft are slightly altered; rigging is a bit soft.
Matterhorn identity is clear. Sky and snow take broken color without wrecking the peak.
Boats and masts held in a photographic rendering. Water still carries a slight brushed look.
Beach figures melt into blobs; faces and limbs are not recoverable. Heavy texture artifacts. Worst content failure in the set.
Garden path looks like a real photo. Path geometry held; palette cooled and some flower detail simplified.
Water and far shore are painterly, but the island church is softened and partly lost.
Mountain lake takes pastel strokes cleanly. Shape held; style is pleasant but generic impressionism.
Pond composition held, yet the result stays dreamy and soft. Not a convincing photograph.
Canal buildings and bridge read photographic with clean edges. Slight grain only.
Broken color on the water works; palazzi stay readable. Sky is a bit washed.
Haystack and field held, but the sky is flattened and contrast is lost. Still partly painterly.
Parliament reads as an architectural photograph. Geometry, windows, and reflection intact.
Sunset sky takes painterly color; headland and surf held. No major geometry breaks.
Domes, caldera, and boats almost unchanged. Looks like a texture filter, not a Monet translation. Weakest style hit.
Cliff and coast held. Sky shows banding and repetitive stroke texture.
